name: Dr. Caroline Meder
headline: Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company
summary: Associate Partner at McKinsey & Company with 10+ years of experience working with industry-leading tech, telco, and consumer-facing companies to drive topline growth through a range of topics especially sales acceleration, go-to-market strategy, (digital) marketing, and pricing. PhD in quantitative marketing from RWTH Aachen.

positions.title: Associate Partner
positions.description: Leader in McKinsey’s Growth, Marketing & Sales and Technology, Media & Telco Practices focused on analytics-driven commercial growth for tech (cloud/AI), telco and consumer companies. Deep expertise in sales, marketing, pricing, and ecommerce.

positions.title: Marketing Analytics & CFO Office
positions.description:
Conducted large-scale econometric research on advertising effectiveness as part of my PhD. As part of the CFO Office and NuCom Operating Office teams, supported portfolio company growth initiatives, investor relations, and commercial due diligences. 

NuCom Group (ProSiebenSat.1 Digital) is the digital unit of ProSiebenSat.1, one of the largest European media and TV conglomerates.

positions.title: Marketing
positions.description:
Developed the marketing concept and product showcase for Clueda's semantic and associative knowledge extraction and analysis software.

Clueda provides real-time big data analytics via event-spotting solutions for security traders and analysts as well as semantic text mining tools for medical scientists. Among others, it was named 'Best in Big Data 2013' by Computerwoche. Acquired in 2015.

positions.title: Digital Product
positions.description: Worked for the Digital Business Unit to build an Android app and develop a business model for advanced urban mapping in London, including integration of crime data, to optimize police force allocation.

positions.title: Country Controlling
positions.description: Analyzed business cases for market entries of financial services entities and derived target approaches for different market types.

positions.title: Chief Technology Office
positions.description: Conducted trend and futures research and worked on developing new business models for sustainable cities.

positions.title: Teleco, Information, Media & Electronics Consultant
positions.description: Assessed a leading European Internet Service Provider's positioning and developed its repositioning strategy and business model.

positions.title: Pricing
positions.description: Developed a pricing model for investment-intensive products and spare parts in mainland China.

company.name: McKinsey & Company
company.description:
McKinsey & Company is a global management consulting firm. We are the trusted advisor to the world's leading businesses, governments, and institutions. 

We work with leading organizations across the private, public and social sectors. Our scale, scope, and knowledge allow us to address problems that no one else can. We have deep functional and industry expertise as well as breadth of geographical reach. We are passionate about taking on immense challenges that matter to our clients and, often, to the world. 

We work with our clients as we do with our colleagues. We build their capabilities and leadership skills at every level and every opportunity. We do this to help build internal support, get to real issues, and reach practical recommendations. We bring out the capabilities of clients to fully participate in the process and lead the ongoing work.
